description: Test 2 cumulative result: all four cloud correctness runs, 1 Nov 2026, staging

phases.name: Environment and migrations
phases.description: Checks service reachability, database schemas, inventory seed count, and the required empty payment table.

phases.name: Inventory validation and pricing
phases.description: Exercises valid reservation pricing plus empty, zero, negative, excessive, duplicate, and unknown-product requests.

assertions.name: price and total come from inventory

phases.name: Atomic inventory rollback
phases.description: Attempts a two-product reservation whose second line lacks stock and verifies no stock or reservation row is partially committed.

assertions.name: first stock update rolled back
assertions.detail: first product inventory must be unchanged

assertions.name: second stock is unchanged
assertions.detail: second product inventory must be unchanged

phases.name: Inventory idempotency
phases.description: Repeats the same order/hash, then changes the hash, checking response reuse, conflict detection, and a single stock mutation.

phases.name: Confirm and release transitions
phases.description: Confirms one reservation and releases another twice, verifying idempotency and preventing contradictory terminal transitions.

assertions.name: release restores availability
assertions.detail: all inventory counters return to starting values

phases.name: Checkout validation
phases.description: Validates a normal checkout and rejects missing idempotency keys, invalid quantities, duplicates, unknown products, and insufficient stock.

assertions.name: valid checkout is accepted by the saga

phases.name: Checkout idempotency and concurrency
phases.description: Checks sequential response replay, canonical item ordering, key/body conflicts, and concurrent retries of one logical checkout.

assertions.name: sequential retry replays the stored response
key reuse with different body is rejected
concurrent retries share one saga
assertions.detail: every retry returns 202 with the same order ID

phases.name: Order command recovery
phases.description: Stops order-service, starts a checkout, waits for the saga sweeper to resend order.create, restarts order-service, and verifies one order is created and the saga completes.

assertions.name: checkout is accepted while order-service is down
no order exists while the participant is down

phases.name: Payment gateway outcome
phases.description: Creates a payment, observes asynchronous processing, and checks the terminal status for the configured simulator mode.

phases.name: Payment idempotency and concurrency
phases.description: Sends concurrent create-payment requests for one order and verifies one database row, one payment ID, and one asynchronous result.

assertions.name: one request creates and retries reuse

phases.name: Successful checkout end to end
phases.description: Runs the checkout saga through payment and inventory confirmation, then cross-checks order, payment, reservation, and stock records.

phases.name: Declined payment end to end
phases.description: Checks that a declined payment cancels the order and releases, rather than consumes, reserved inventory.
notes: Run a fresh disposable stack with GATEWAY_MODE=decline to execute this phase.

phases.name: Ambiguous payment timeout
phases.description: Checks that an unknown gateway outcome keeps the order pending and its stock reserved for later reconciliation.
notes: Run a fresh disposable stack with GATEWAY_MODE=timeout to execute this phase.

phases.name: Payment command recovery
phases.description: Stops payment-service, starts a checkout, waits for the saga sweeper to resend payment.initiate, restarts payment-service, and verifies one payment and a completed saga.

assertions.name: checkout is accepted while payment-service is down
order stays pending while payment is unavailable
assertions.detail: never paid without a confirmed payment

assertions.name: stock is held but not consumed

phases.name: Concurrent limited-stock checkout
phases.description: Runs 50 distinct checkouts against ten units and verifies exactly ten winners, no oversell, and no negative counters.

phases.name: Multi-item deadlock resistance
phases.description: Submits concurrent two-item carts in opposite input order and verifies canonical locking prevents deadlocks and timeouts.

assertions.name: all opposite-order carts complete
assertions.detail: no deadlocks, transport timeouts, or conflicts

phases.name: Terminal order state idempotency
phases.description: Replays the checkout of a PAID order and verifies the same order ID, stable state, one payment, and one inventory movement.
notes: EXPIRED is not externally triggerable in the current API; its release path needs an expiry worker or test clock before black-box coverage is possible.

phases.name: HTTP error mapping
phases.description: Sends malformed IDs, missing resources, invalid payment data, and checkout conflicts to verify stable client-facing status codes.

phases.name: Transaction boundary
phases.description: Samples pg_stat_activity during the checkout saga and fails if an application connection waits on network I/O while idle inside a database transaction.

assertions.name: actionable background jobs drain before sampling
assertions.detail: timed out waiting for the worker backlog

assertions.name: no idle transaction crosses service calls

phases.name: Database invariants
phases.description: Scans all three schemas for negative/oversold stock, duplicate business keys, and cross-service terminal-state contradictions.

assertions.name: actionable background jobs drain before audit
assertions.detail: timed out waiting for the worker backlog

assertions.name: payment amounts match order totals in paise
